_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Uri Mchezaji {player_id} mukati me michezo ye LinesOfAction.
Maseza ako ndi '{side}', maseza e nhamussua ndi '{other}'.
Mfumo we kuenda: `[b1b3]` (kuratidzwa kwe kuendeswa kwa mchezaji). Kuenda kwakabvumidzwa kunofamba kwa mwelekeo wa mlalo, wemusoro, kana diagonal, kwa idadi ye miraba inofanana ne jumla ye maseza (ye ruvara rese) mukati me mstari uyo. Unaweza kudarika maseza ako, asi maseza e nhamussua; kugara pamusoro pe mchezaji we nhamussua kunomukamata.  Uhwine mukati me maseza ako yose akabatana.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Kufamba kunofanira kuva kwakarurama kana kuti kwakaganhurirwa.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Inofanira kufamba chinhambwe chakaenzana nezvidimbu zviri mumutsetse.
